headline: More outlets report fan PC-port projects for the leaked build being shut down; Rockstar still has not commented.
summary: PC Gamer, VGC and Decrypt (Tier 2) report on Nov 24 that the Leonida fan PC-port project went offline and its leads stepped back. Decrypt, with its own reporting, adds that a second porting Discord server was removed and others locked down, that the project's GitHub page shows a plain not-found page rather than a takedown notice, and that Rockstar did not respond to its request for comment (added to c007). Whether Rockstar or Take-Two was behind any takedown is still only the creator's claim. No label changes. Main question still Not established. No Rockstar or Take-Two statement, new court filing or arrest found. Privacy check done (no individuals named). We opened no leak, download or project sites.
author: Research agent
